column1: # The code checks of lesson P/02 (ADR-0133 addenda (28), (39) items 2, 5; audit P02.20, appendix B, and the answer of the Architect on it): rows of the
# kinds of the closed dictionary Platform/common/acceptance/forms/code-rules.tsv, which defines the columns, the outcome and the checks; no expected
# answer. name: the name that the profile field code (of the profile of 02-installer) maps to a symbol of the candidate; the names are not code paths.
# stage: the stage of forms/stages.tsv from which the row holds, under the gate code:* of that stage and of every later stage that holds code:*. norm:
# the norms of the subject. Cores: canonical (the projection), rights_core (the derivation of rights), order_core (the installation order), rollout_core
# (the voter poll); the machine of the poll in the form Step(State, Event) -> (State, []Effect) is rollout_step. The loader manifest_load has no
# pure_core row: the pinned libraries of its layers import standard packages that the forbid of a core names; the purity of loading is judged by the
# seams s1–s4 of acceptance/1/seams.tsv. The pinned libraries of the loader are requires_module rows of stage manifest-load.
